read.title: Change to Q3 Planning Meeting
read.text:
Hi team,

I'm writing to let you know that the Q3 planning meeting has been postponed from Monday to Thursday, July 10, at 2 p.m. Several attendees are traveling early next week, and we want everyone in the room for this discussion.

The agenda is still tentative, but we plan to cover three topics: the sales forecast, the hiring plan, and the new product timeline. If you would like to add an item, please reply by Tuesday noon.

Please also review the attached report before the meeting so that we can keep the discussion short and focused.

Thanks,
Mina

write.task: 다음 주 화요일 거래처 미팅에 갈 수 없게 되었어요. 상대에게 정중하게 일정 변경을 요청하는 짧은 이메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short, polite email asking a business partner to reschedule next Tuesday's meeting because you can't attend.
hints: I'm afraid I can't make it
write.model:
Hi Mr. Brown,

I'm afraid I can't make it to our meeting next Tuesday because of an urgent internal review. Would it be possible to reschedule for Thursday or Friday afternoon? Please let me know which time works best for you. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Minsu
